what_changed: Python 3.14.0 (released 2025-10-07) made the free-threaded (no-GIL) build officially supported (PEP 779) and added template string literals (t-strings, PEP 750), deferred annotation evaluation (PEP 649), multiple interpreters (PEP 734), and an experimental JIT.
old_option: Python 3.9/3.10-era patterns (GIL-bound threading, f-string-only string processing)
new_option: Python 3.14 (officially supported free-threaded build, t-string template literals)

what_changed: The React team officially deprecated Create React App on 2025-02-14, recommending new apps use a framework (Next.js, React Router, Expo) or a build tool like Vite, Parcel, or Rsbuild instead.
new_option: Vite (npm create vite) or a framework like Next.js / React Router / Expo

what_changed: React 19 (stable Dec 5, 2024) added Actions (useActionState, useFormStatus, useOptimistic), the use() API, and ref as a regular prop, cementing function components with hooks as the standard over legacy class components and lifecycle methods like componentWillMount (deprecated since React 16.3 and removed as UNSAFE_-unprefixed names).
old_option: class components with legacy lifecycle methods (componentWillMount, forwardRef, useFormState)
new_option: function components with hooks: Actions/useActionState, use(), ref as prop

what_changed: Pydantic v2.0, released June 30, 2023, rewrote the validation core in Rust and deprecated v1 APIs such as @validator/@root_validator and class Config in favor of @field_validator/@model_validator and model_config = ConfigDict(...).

Tailwind CSS v4.0 replaced the JavaScript tailwind.config.js configuration with CSS-first configuration via @theme in your stylesheet, along with a rewritten high-performance engine and a single-line @import "tailwindcss" setup.
FastAPI 0.93.0 added lifespan async context manager support for startup/shutdown, deprecating the @app.on_event("startup"/"shutdown") event handlers.
new_option: lifespan async context manager passed as FastAPI(lifespan=...)

what_changed: OpenAI released GPT-5 on August 7, 2025, a unified flagship model that became the default in ChatGPT and the API, superseding the GPT-4o/GPT-4 family (and legacy gpt-3.5-turbo) for new development.

Astral's uv (first released Feb 2024 as a Rust-based pip replacement) expanded on 2024-08-20 into a unified Python packaging tool ("Cargo for Python") — uv run/lock/sync, uv tool/uvx, and uv python install — replacing pip, virtualenv, pipx, pyenv, and requirements.txt-style workflows.
new_option: uv (uv add, uv sync, uv run, uv lock with pyproject.toml + uv.lock)

what_changed: ESLint v9.0.0 made flat config (eslint.config.js) the default configuration format and officially deprecated the legacy eslintrc format.

Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 (model ID claude-opus-5), now the newest generally-available Claude model at $5/$25 per MTok, superseding retired Claude 3.x models like claude-3-5-sonnet and claude-3-opus.
